identity.title: Top Secret Internal Team Plasma Genesect Video

leadText: (Japanese: プラズマ団内部のゲノセクト極秘映像 Top Secret Internal Team Plasma Genesect Video) is an animated short that was made to promote Genesect and the Legend Awakened. It was first screened at the '13 Winter, which was held at the in , Japan on January 20, 2013, in , Japan from January 26 to 27, 2013, the in , Japan on February 3, 2013, and at the in , Japan on February 10, 2013. It was subsequently posted on the official Japanese YouTube channel to promote the TCG expansion on February 15, 2013, and was made available on the service in Japan alongside the March 7 trailer for the movie from March 13 to April 23, 2013. A Korean dub was released on the official Korean YouTube channel on May 8, 2013.

(Japanese: プラズマ団内部のゲノセクト極秘映像 Top Secret Internal Team Plasma Genesect Video) is an animated short that was made to promote Genesect and the Legend Awakened. It was first screened at the '13 Winter, which was held at the in , Japan on January 20, 2013, in , Japan from January 26 to 27, 2013, the in , Japan on February 3, 2013, and at the in , Japan on February 10, 2013. It was subsequently posted on the official Japanese YouTube channel to promote the TCG expansion on February 15, 2013, and was made available on the service in Japan alongside the March 7 trailer for the movie from March 13 to April 23, 2013. A Korean dub was released on the official Korean YouTube channel on May 8, 2013.

==Plot==
The short details "Project G", Team Plasma's plan to revive and modify . It introduces the four Drives that Genesect can use, Genesect's normal configuration, high-speed flight configuration, and a Genesect who can use .

==Characters==
===Humans===
Team Plasma member (voice only)

(Genesect Army; ×5)

==Trivia==
The portion of the video depicting a computer interface with a rotating diagram of Genesect in the center and several windows on both sides resembles the screen that views at the beginning of The Name's N!.
Project G is mentioned by name in Team Plasma's Pokémon Manipulation!, when a informs Ghetsis that a search party has not yet been able to locate the target for the project.
